results.title: The Healthcare Payer's Algorithm — VII : AI in Regulatory ...
results.content: # The Healthcare Payer’s Algorithm — VII : AI in Regulatory Compliance and Reporting. ## A practical guide to mitigating risk by using AI to automate the monitoring of regulatory changes, streamline the generation of complex reports, and transform vast policy corpora into intelligent, searchable knowledge bases for mission-critical decision support. > **Tl;dr:** Healthcare payers are drowning in complex, ever-changing regulations, leading to massive administrative costs and significant financial risk from non-compliance. This research details how AI — specifically generative and agentic AI — is moving from a futuristic concept to a practical necessity, automating everything from regulatory monitoring to audit preparation, saving hundreds of millions, and creating a more reliable healthcare system. The healthcare payer industry is contending with a crippling and unsustainable reality: an explosion of regulatory complexity that our traditional, manual processes were never built to handle. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
